title: Jelly Roll's daughter addresses 'hate' after admitting she was 'disgusted' following Bunnie Xo split - NewsBreak
text:
By Jorge Solis ,
44 minutes ago Jelly Roll's daughter, Bailee Ann DeFord, addressed the hate she's seen online surrounding her dad's divorce filing from her stepmom, Bunnie Xo.
On June 15, Jelly Roll , 41, filed for divorce from his wife Bunnie, also known as Alisa DeFord, in Tennessee back in May, according to the obtained court records. The divorce was reportedly a mutual decision made by the former couple. The exes' split was a private family matter that has remained out of the public eye until June 17, when his daughter Bailee, whom he shares with ex Felicia Beckwith, took to social media to comment on the divisive situation.
Bailee mentioned she has been seeing "a lot of hate" targeting her father and his former partner. This came after Post Malone shared disappointing news with fans as he abruptly axed six dates on his tour with the country singer.

In a TikTok video, Jelly Rolly's daughter started off, "I can say on a more positive note - thank you to everyone who is showing e so much love and kindness through everything.
"At the end of the day, no matter what, we are all humans with feelings and that is worthy of compassion."
She thanked her followers for "the kind messages, the words of support" that made her feel "protected and seen."
She focused on the disdain and wrote, "I will never forget those of you that have shown me empathy when I'm seeing a lot of hate. I hope humanity can evolve to a place where kindness comes first. I understand and respect opinions and that a public profile is a public profile, but that doesn't have to mean we throw away our human decency."
A day before, the 18-year-old wrote in a TikTok post about how she was "disgusted" with the intense attention toward the split.
“I am disgusted at how invested everyone is in a very clearly private family matter," she shared. "It’s f- -kn crazy. Go on somewhere yall. Worry ‘bout your house — not mine. I’m not speaking on it — yet.”
According in the documents, Jelly Roll alleged that the “parties are unable to live together successfully as husband and wife.”
Additionally, in Jelly Roll's filing there was a proposition included when it came to splitting the assets between he and Bunnie Xo, explaining that the divorcing couple shared “an equitable division of the parties’ assets,” and also “responsibility for payment of the parties’ debts.”
Their split comes as a shock to fans as the two appeared to be in love given them displaying much affection at the 2026 Grammy Awards in February.
